title: VEL-MER-JUDGE-01 — judging girls based on their bags (Meridian, insecurity mirror)

cards.text: VEL-MER-JUDGE-01 — JUDGING GIRLS BASED ON THEIR BAGS (MERIDIAN, INSECURITY MIRROR)

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Mirror of the 'judging girls based on their bags with little to no explanation' reel. A deadpan creator in a small selfie window bottom-left reads four luxury bags off real street-style stills, each with a score and one dry verdict (praise plus a trade-off, nothing below 7), then the Meridian lands a 10 because nobody can place the brand and she paid what the bag is worth. From 0:32 the script is the house formula: intro, attribute stack, lived proof, laptop and zip demo, six colors, live sale, link. Angle VEL-A-001 'what my bag says about me'. Target feeling: she checks which bag is hers, winces, then wants the one that scored ten. Runtime 64.6s, one VO take, hard cuts, no music.

cards.title: OUR VERSION  ·  VEL-MER-JUDGE-01 · 64.6s · VO take A (Woman Over 40) · creator window bottom-left · real stills, no generation

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: THE ONE THING
cards.text: Every verdict is praise plus a trade-off. Nothing scores under 7. The reference sneers; we do not. If a line would make a Saint Laurent owner feel stupid, it is the wrong line, because she is the avatar.

cards.title: DO
cards.text: Deadpan read, score first. Title card up through the 10/10 beat, then gone. Creator in a rectangular selfie window on a plain grey wall, bottom-left, jumping bottom-right on the Meridian beat only. Hard cuts, no music, one VO take. Real stills only.

cards.title: DON'T
cards.text: No Hermes by name. No competitor price. No dupe, replica or alternative wording. No brass (hardware is silver). No dimensions. No spoken price. No generated bags, ours or theirs.

cards.title: FLAGGED FOR BROOKS
cards.text: 1. Tone softened from the reference by house law; say the word and the bite comes back one line at a time. 2. Product intro lands at 0:32, not 0:06, because the judging list is the angle. 3. The four judged-bag stills are real, unlicensed Pinterest photos, same open ruling as the grid builds. 4. Meridian inventory was oversold on 8/21; all six colorways show available today, confirm before spend.

cards.title: CREATOR
cards.text: Default Claire, 45 (honey blonde, glasses on head, camel cardigan). Alternates Eleanor, 48 and Helen, 52 on the moodboard. Voice: Woman Over 40, one take, 64.6s. HeyGen Avatar V render fires only after this board is approved.
